knockout.note: every round; model.core replaced by a ModuleList without the blocks (run() builds K/V and zips core per call), restored after

train_loss.note: row-weighted mean of model.loss() terms on group-only batches of 64, teacher forced, no_grad; op_acc / copy_share are batch means

dev_loss.note: gold log-likelihood = the teacher-forced loss on the 5 dev splits (pooled-5), batches of 64 grouped by split x family

R1.rule: oracle-mode 10M gain >= +3.0 (vs +1.64) -> routing masks the thinker (cause 6) -> marginal mode loss test next

R2.rule: skipping blocks 3-8 at 10M costs < 1.0 point in_dist -> idle depth (cause 7 or 2) -> short lr test (5e-4 vs 1e-3)

R3.rule: skill-term (non-cloze) teacher-forced train loss at 10M <= half of 3M, with dev flat (G1 gain +1.64) -> memorisation (cause 2) confirmed
R3.dev_flat_note: the sealed rule gives no cutoff for "dev flat"; D reads it as D's recomputed normal pooled-5 gain < 3.0; judge from the numbers
